name: meeting-notes
description: macOS only: take timestamped meeting notes in a pane, optionally record your mic and the call's audio, and get a local transcript and a summary when you stop.

notesDir.title: Notes folder
notesDir.description: Where each meeting gets its own folder; ~ is your home folder.

micDevice.title: Microphone
micDevice.description: Audio input name as macOS lists it; "default" follows the system input.

callAudio.title: Call audio
callAudio.description: system records everything the Mac plays through the built-in helper; device records the loopback input named below; off records the microphone only.

meetingDevice.title: Call audio device
meetingDevice.description: Loopback input used when Call audio is device, such as "BlackHole 2ch".

whisperModel.title: Whisper model
whisperModel.description: Path to the whisper.cpp ggml model used for the transcript.

language.title: Spoken language
language.description: Whisper language code such as de or en, or auto to detect it.

summaryModel.title: Summary model
summaryModel.description: Model alias or id that writes the summary.

keepAudio.title: Keep audio
keepAudio.description: Keep the recording as audio.m4a beside the notes.
